spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid_meanrev
spec.hypothesis: Extreme short-horizon taker (aggressor) volume imbalance in top-liquidity names predicts 10-minute mean-reversion, net of realistic T1 costs -- tests the signal cleanly, away from the tail-liquidity altbasket cost trap that sank sprint32/34.
spec.power_argument: ~20 liquid names x ~1 qualifying |z|>=2 imbalance event/day, cap 2 entries/day/name, over a 20-day sealed window -> ~400 trades (>=300 target). Liquid-name net-return SD ~40bps (vs ~180bps in altbasket) gives MDE ~4.6bps at n=300/t=2; pass threshold set at mean_net>8bps (2x MDE) so the criterion can fail under the null (exp14 lesson).
